origin.description: Steady state of a 2-D difference scheme.
origin.usage: steady.2D(y, time = 0, func, parms = NULL, nspec = NULL, dimens, method = "stodes", ...)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: dimens
arguments.text: Two box counts. nspec * prod(dimens) is the length of y.

origin.details: The default method is the sparse Newton. The state is stored column-major, one species at a time.
origin.value: A steady2D list with dimens and nspec.

translation.description: Steady state of a 2-D difference scheme.
translation.usage: steady_2d(y, times=None, func=None, parms=None, nspec=None, dimens=None, method="stodes", **kwargs)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: dimens
arguments.text: Two box counts. nspec * prod(dimens) is the length of y.

translation.details: The default method is the sparse Newton. The state is stored column-major, one species at a time.
translation.value: A steady2D list with dimens and nspec.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from rootSolve import steady_2d

def g(t, y, p):
    grid = np.asarray(list(y), dtype=float).reshape((3, 3), order="F")
    change = grid * 0
    for row in range(3):
        for col in range(3):
            left = 0.0 if row == 0 else grid[row - 1, col]
            right = 1.0 if row == 2 else grid[row + 1, col]
            down = 0.0 if col == 0 else grid[row, col - 1]
            up = 0.0 if col == 2 else grid[row, col + 1]
            change[row, col] = left + right + down + up - 4 * grid[row, col]
    return [change.reshape(-1, order="F")]

print(steady_2d([0.2] * 9, func=g, dimens=(3, 3)))
